contract.peers: two separate address spaces with one worker each
contract.validation: every sequence and every deterministic payload byte
contract.rpc: one outstanding copied request and equal-sized copied echo
contract.stream: one-way copied messages; empty completion ACK per window including final partial window
contract.aggregate_timing: two clock reads per batch; setup, output and diagnostic snapshots excluded
contract.latency_timing: two clock reads per RPC, included and not subtracted; never one-way latency

metadata.qemu_acceleration: TCG default (no KVM); guest timer values are not physical CPU cycles
metadata.transport_framing: copied packed records; legacy FIRST/LAST fallback
metadata.tx_backpressure: cursor/credit wait in blocking mode; CPU relax in spin mode
metadata.clock_implementation: mx_clock_ns syscall; platform-corrected monotonic system counter
metadata.background: isolated bundle: bootstrap parent parks; two trusted worker processes; ordinary services absent

summary.uncertainty_method: 2000 seeded bootstrap resamples of independent run medians; small run counts give coarse intervals
summary.quantiles: nearest rank; p99.9 withheld below 10000 pooled samples; RTT includes clock instrumentation
warnings: Some run medians vary by more than 10%; inspect interference before attributing changes.
